title: In-Situ Simultaneous Magic State Injection on Arbitrary CSS qLDPC Codes
authors: Liu, Xu, Jochym-O'Connor, He, Singh, Ding
conversion_notes: The paper explicitly simulates logical Y-state injection as a Clifford proxy. At each selected injection site replace the |Y> initialization (RY, equivalently RX then S) by |T> initialization (RX then T); preserve all other initialization, entangling and syndrome-extraction operations. Reassess final Y-basis readout, detectors and observables, which need not remain deterministic for |T>.
notes: Author-released repository and paper data-availability statement verified. README identifies inject_y_v2.py and inject_y_v2_xu_hgp.py and build_msi_circuit entry points; simulations cover [[144,12,12]] BB and [[225,9,4]] HGP. Noise and verification changes may be needed; a converted circuit is not a Stim stabilizer simulation.

title: Transversal Dimension Jump for Product qLDPC Codes
conversion_notes: CCZCircuit.py builds stim.Circuit objects and uses ccz_pauli_circuit with weight-five correlated Z faults as a surrogate, not an ideal CCZ. Insert physical CCZ for each nonzero P_CCZ_mat[i][j][k] between corresponding data_indices_b1[i], data_indices_b2[j], data_indices_b3[k], at the surrogate stage; retain or adapt the noise. Export and postprocess text because standard Stim cannot construct CCZ. Reconsider X-basis final detectors and logical observables for the actual non-Clifford state.
notes: Paper links author simulation repository; its CCZ error-detection simulation is not an ideal CCZ circuit. The matrix construction and depth scheduling need checking for the chosen code, and adding gates changes the experiment.
